_comment: v10.1 singles tactics: tag thresholds, cues and review findings. Distances in metres, times in seconds. Cues are coaching cues, written to be true on a real court.

spread.cue_zh: 把对手拉开，再找空档：一拍后场，一拍前场。
spread.cue_en: Stretch them first, then find the space: one deep, one short.

space.cue_zh: 打人不在的地方，不是打人站的地方。
space.cue_en: Hit where they are not, not where they stand.

transition.cue_zh: 被动时先把球挑高挑远，争取回中心的时间。
transition.cue_en: Under pressure, lift high and deep to buy time to recover.

risky.cue_zh: 位置不好不硬杀：底线来不及时先打高远或吊球。
risky.cue_en: Don't force the smash off balance at the baseline: clear or drop instead.

backhand.cue_zh: 反手后场是多数业余选手最弱的地方，多往那里压。
backhand.cue_en: The rear backhand corner is most club players' weakest spot: press it.

smashNet.cue_zh: 杀完别站着，跟上去封网，对手回过来的多半是网前球。
smashNet.cue_en: Don't admire the smash: follow it in, the reply usually comes short.

netClear.zh: 过网要留高度：吊球和放网瞄网带上方一拍的高度。
netClear.en: Give the net some room: aim drops and net shots a racket-length above the tape.

inside.zh: 打深但别打出界：瞄底线以内半米、边线以内半米。
inside.en: Deep but in: aim half a metre inside the baseline and the sideline.

shadow.zh: 看影子判断落点，等球落到击球点再出手，不要追着球挥。
shadow.en: Read the shadow, wait for the shuttle to reach your hitting point; don't chase it with the racket.

base.zh: 打完一拍先回中心，下一拍才来得及。
base.en: After every shot, get back to the centre first.

unforced.zh: {lost} 个失分里有 {n} 个是主动失误，多数是{shot}{why}。
unforced.en: {n} of your {lost} lost points were unforced errors, mostly {shot} {why}.

timing.zh: 你的出手平均{dir}了 {ms} 毫秒。

far.zh: 有 {n} 分是被调动后够不到：对手把你拉开了。
far.en: {n} points were lost chasing: your opponent pulled you out of position.

spread.zh: 落点太集中：{shots} 拍里只有 {n} 拍把对手拉开。
spread.en: Too predictable: only {n} of {shots} shots moved your opponent.

good.zh: 打得扎实：{w} 个制胜球，主动失误只有 {n} 个。
good.en: Solid: {w} winners and only {n} unforced errors.
